Pricing Addendum

This addendum to the Merchant Agreement between Razorpay Software Private Limited and Indigo Loom sets out the transaction discount rate (TDR) applicable from 1 September 2026.

Payment methodTDR
UPI1.50%
Debit cards (transaction value up to ₹2,000)0.40%
Debit cards (transaction value above ₹2,000)0.90%
RuPay debit cardsNil
Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard)1.80%
RuPay credit cards1.60%
American Express3.00%
Diners Club3.00%
International cards3.50%
Net banking1.90% + ₹2 per transaction
Wallets1.90%
EMI and Pay Later2.50%

GST at 18% will be charged extra on all fees.

Settlements will be made on a T+2 working day basis.

All other terms of the Merchant Agreement remain unchanged.
